page_topic_one_liner: Glossary-driven growth — A–Z term pages, topical authority, evergreen traffic, and knowledge-graph internal linking
differentiator_vs_generic: This is SEO glossary content strategy, NOT GEO/LLM chat. Hero must be a recognizable A–Z glossary index with alphabet nav and interconnected term entries — NOT a generic dictionary app or AI definition chat.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): glossary index page mockup — vertical A–Z alphabet sidebar (letters as pills), main column with 5–6 term rows (blurred term titles + one-line definition blur), one row accent-highlighted
Secondary: knowledge-graph hub — central glossary node with 6–8 spoke lines to related term nodes (entity SEO topical map)
Tertiary: evergreen traffic growth curve ascending gently (line chart blur, no axis labels)
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is glossary SEO strategy not GEO)
Generic pocket dictionary without A–Z index layout
Empty term list or placeholder lorem cards
Paid ads dashboard unrelated to content moat
